_comment: Left out on purpose as a secret: 110 BEZHLAVĚ (JÍT BEZHLAVĚ in the forest 97/98 is a hidden shortcut to the cottage, notes 97:110 / 98:110); the UI must not hint at it. Scenery nouns (dictionary indices from ITEM_WORDS, 1-based) that the game handles specifically in a room although IVEN does not place them there (IVEN = 0, or IVEN names a single room while the handler accepts more rooms). Built by reading MMM_LAT/MMS[B-K].FOR; every entry is cited in notes as 'room:noun'. Line numbers refer to MMM_LAT/*.FOR. Verb names are the dictionary verbs (synonyms in brackets are remapped in MMSB.FOR:569-623). Nouns 109 ZÁVĚS -> 91 and 112 KOULE -> 30 are remapped in MMSB.FOR:496-498, so only 91/30 are listed. Not room-bound and therefore left out: 107 SÍDLO (ZÁHADA SÍDLO -> 'To je jméno hry.' anywhere, MMSH.FOR:934-941), 71 BODY (SKÓRE BODY anywhere, +2 points on turn 13 of every 25, MMSF.FOR:70-81), 61 JED (synonym of AMPULE 13, MMSB.FOR:558), 104 TISKÁRNA / 105 KAZETA (ZAZNAMENAT ... NA TISKÁRNU/KAZETU, session-logging meta commands, MMSJ.FOR:437-449), 92 DVEŘE / 93 BRÁNA with OLEJOVAT ('již to je' anywhere, MMSJ.FOR:400-404), 54 ZÁMEK (follows the chest, see 'follows'). Never handled anywhere (no entry): 80 SOCHA, 81 FIGURÍNA, 82 MODLA, 86 NOVÁ, 87 STARÁ, 106 STŘÍBRNÁ (adjectives dropped in MMSB.FOR:521-540), 111 BALVAN (not mapped to 83). Door state in IXT is Z=2 locked / Z=1 unlocked (MMSJ.FOR:114-118 and 139-140, MMSC.FOR:453-457), opposite to the comment in MMM.FOR. Door verbs act only on the exit in the direction the player last moved or turned to (ITST(4)/1000, MMSF.FOR:1335, MMSJ.FOR:92); otherwise 'Před Vámi nejsou dveře'. OBRÁTIT/OTOČIT <směr> turns the player (MMSF.FOR:1665-1688).

follows._comment: Noun 54 ZÁMEK means the lock of TRUHLA 35: meaningful wherever the chest is in the room (IVEN(35) = 6xx with xx = room) or carried. ODEMKNOUT/ZAMKNOUT ZÁMEK (MMSJ.FOR:155-185: needs chest here or carried; unlock with KLÍČE says 'Klíče nepasují do zámku', ZAMKNOUT -> 'již to je'/text 2010), ROZBÍT ZÁMEK (MMSJ.FOR:582-614: chest must lie in this room, needs SEKERA/MEČ/KYJ/LOPATKA/SEKERKA -> 'Rozmlátil jste zámek na kousky', opens the lock, MMSK.FOR:215-217), STŘELIT/ZASTŘELIT ZÁMEK (MMSJ.FOR:211-305: needs PISTOLE; note it does not check the chest's room). Initial chest room is 25.
